investigation_notes.Description: Anomalous DNS tunneling activity was detected on endpoint srv-prod-infra-01 originating from 192.168.153.249 targeting 172.16.40.3. The DNS payload contained high-entropy data totaling 313 bytes, significantly higher than the typical 50 bytes, and included query names resembling SharePoint/CDN related endpoints. This pattern is indicative of potential DNS tunneling or data exfiltration attempts, warranting high-priority investigation to confirm legitimacy and prevent potential data loss.
